title: Turn Claude Code Into a Free AI Video Studio
description:
OpenMontage is a free, open-source tool that turns Claude Code into a full AI video production studio. You describe the video in plain language and the agent handles the whole pipeline: scripting, pulling real footage from open archives, generating visuals, voiceover, and editing. It has a zero-key path that runs locally with Piper TTS and Archive.org footage, rendering with Remotion and FFmpeg, so you can make explainers, trailers, ads, and educational videos for free. Full setup and the exact prompts are in the guide below.

Get the OpenMontage setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1kioWrt9ZfxrgJFr_yUfSBs_OaJBo-fTw/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
